data.description: An interior theatre space within a museum setting. The theatre contains front-row seating, a stage with a curtain, and a tape deck. Dust drifts through an unlit projector beam housing. The space is accessed via a locked door and connects to a corridor beyond.
data.name: Museum Theatre
data.narrative_significance: The Museum Theatre serves as a liminal space where past and present converge. It is the setting for Iva's encounter with a mysterious elderly visitor who knew Mara, and later becomes the site of an uncanny repetition of a recorded line. The theatre functions as a repository of memory and mystery, where a repaired porcelain bird and a discarded scarf suggest unresolved connections to Mara's past. The space facilitates communication across time through recorded audio and unexplained vocal presences.
